preprocessing: grayscale; centered black square padding; Lanczos resize; mild training augmentation; per-image z-normalization
label_smoothing_provenance: Paper specifies smoothing but not coefficient; 0.1 is a predeclared reconstruction choice common to all four groups.
noise_provenance: JBO Section 2.5.1 final D1/OCT2017 configuration; not tuned on our validation or test data.
batch_contract: 2x2 static/dynamic x no-noise/noise; common label smoothing 0.1; historical dynamic batch used 0.0 and remains separate.
external_testing: Once all four predeclared single-seed runs complete and their checkpoint hashes are frozen; no external tuning
NEH_rule: discard DME logit, softmax remaining CNV/DRUSEN/NORMAL; also save original four-class probabilities
OCT_C8_rule: loader includes CNV/DME/DRUSEN/NORMAL only; master files unchanged
